messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 429/503 ratio observed on api-gateway-prod. 5m rolling 429 = 8.3% (threshold 1%), 503 = 1.2%. Start=2634509870. Paging @oncall :rotating_light:
jon: grabbing pager. seeing the same on the high-level heatmap. tags: region=us-west, route=/v1/generate, model=llama-13b.
maria: plotting frontend vs backend 429s — looks like spike correlates with increased cache-miss rate on KV cache and a surge of long-sequence requests. Grafana dash -> https://grafana.internal/d/ai/latency-429 (safe link)
ameer: can we confirm whether this is client-side retry storm or backend capacity? pulled logs: increased p95 token length + a burst of tenant `acme-inc` traffic.
lisa: any customer-facing errors? support queue shows a handful of new 429s but no large outage emails yet.
jon: action plan: 1) apply temporary per-tenant soft cap for tenants > 1k qps (targeted) 2) throttle non-critical endpoints (embeddings-prefetch, background-rerank) 3) enable degraded-mode routing to a smaller model variant for high-cost routes. I'll hand commands to infra.
maria: metrics to watch during mitigation:
```
# Prometheus-ish queries
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api-gateway",status=~"4.."}[1m])) by (status)
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api-gateway",route="/v1/generate"}[1m])) by (tenant)
sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total[1m]))
```
Please watch 429 ratio and backend 5xx concurrently.
ameer: applying tenant soft-cap via rate-shield API now. Payload: 
```
POST https://admin.internal/v1/ratelimit
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
{
  "selector": {"tenant_id": "acme-inc"},
  "rules": [{"type":"soft_cap","qps":1200,"burst":200}]
}
```
ameer: response 200. Rule active -> rule-id: rs-7832.
jon: good. next, toggle feature flag to disable embeddings-prefetch for non-enterprise accounts (will drop background heavy calls).
lisa: use the featureflag service? example: 
```
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/flags/disable -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"flag":"embeddings_prefetch","scope":"non_enterprise","duration_s":900}'
```
lisa: flag API replied success. flag id ff-992. ops-bot: note: changed ff-992 by lisa at 2634509912.
ops-bot: applying secondary mitigation: route rebalancer nudged 10% traffic from us-west -> us-east warm pool to ease local node queues.
maria: dashboards updating — 429s for /v1/generate from acme-inc dropped from 14%->4% in the last 1m window. total 503s flat but expected to drop after queue drains.
jon: good. keep watch for client retries. if 429s persist > 5% for 10m escalate to throttling other high qps tenants. Also prepare to enable circuit-breaker at gateway for very long sequences.
ameer: prepped curl to enable gateway CB: 
```
POST https://admin.internal/v1/circuit-breaker
{ "target":"gateway","criteria": {"p95_latency_ms": 1200}, "action": "failfast" }
```
jon: don't enable CB yet unless p95 > 1200ms and error rates stay high.
maria: small note — prefix/KV cache eviction rate spiked, may need to tune `kv_cache_ttl_ms` back up after mitigation to avoid cold starts.
lisa: I'm drafting a short customer note for affected customers (ACME + others) to send if we see elevated error volume continue. keep me updated.
incident-bot: Metric check at 2634509930: 429 5m = 3.9%, 503 5m = 0.6%. Mitigations: tenant soft-cap rs-7832, flag ff-992, rebalancer shift. Oncall: jon, please monitor 15m and close thread when stable. :white_check_mark:
